title: New Here
note: Permanent. Runs every week, first. Only change it when Ben asks.
bullets: First time here? We're really glad you came. No pressure, no spotlight.
Scan or tap the QR code in front of you. Takes 30 seconds.
We'll give $10 to a local charity in your honor. Your visit already made a difference.
And we'll pray for you by name this week.
